a.lede: Trump says he spoke to the board and that Huang "did nothing wrong."
a.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, board chair

b.lede: Huang faces ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence who previously worked for a company that has been accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China.
b.title: Trump reportedly says pardoning Jensen Huang is ‘an option’
